SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-12'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT MAX(sale_date) AS max_sale, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join, (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS max_cal
FROM fact_sales_line

WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_versions,
           COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_join_dates
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MAX(n_versions) AS max_versions, MAX(n_join_dates) AS max_joindates,
       SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from <> join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_mismatch
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'members whose any version has join_date 3 Oct but first version does not' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING MIN(join_date) <> MAX(join_date)) 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate member_id with same valid_from', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_member_updates join 3 Oct', COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
